title: DO BETTERRRRR
body:
I’m beyond frustrated. Why on earth is data validation – a BASIC spreadsheet function – not available on the Google Sheets mobile app? You can fold phones, put AI in everything, and brag about “productivity on the go,” yet I can’t even add a simple dropdown? What century are we in?

This isn’t just annoying — it’s exclusionary. Not everyone has access to a laptop all the time. Some of us are working, building, creating systems for others — using the tools available. And the fact that you deliberately limit core features behind desktop access just shows how little you care about accessibility or actual productivity.

This isn’t smart tech. This is modern tech gatekeeping.
Fix your app. People deserve better.

title: Heavy Google Sheets users should avoid iPad
body:
The Google Sheets on iPad simply lacks basic functionalities that are readily available on the Chrome browser version for Windows.  
My issues:
1. Creating formulas referencing cells from other worksheets is not as intuitive as pointing to the worksheets and the target cells.  
2. Selecting cells not adjacent to each other to view the sum (average, count, etc.) is not possible.
3. Shifting from one worksheet to another takes extra clicks/steps.

iPads and Google apps don’t mix.

title: It snaps from time to time.
body:
It randomly crashes from time to time. Like when you're offline, it will just stop working then closes itself. But when you opened it again, it will work perfectly fine. Another encounter was it will just close itself at your first try opening it with an internet connection. Then on the second, it will just work well.

Also, on this update, they removed the green dot option where it will copy the data from one cell to the next one.
